// Comments beside raw strings, digit separators and line splices.
auto raw = R"x(a)" /* not a comment */ ")x"; // after a raw string
auto prefixed = u8R"(// not a comment)"; /* after a prefixed raw string */
// this comment runs on \
   onto the next line through a splice
int slash = '/'*2; // after a character literal next to an asterisk
int thousand = 1'000; // after a digit separator
auto narrow = u8'/'; /* after a prefixed character */
#define LIMIT 10 /* after a macro's value */
#if 0
// in a skipped branch
#endif
